title: About Me
text: I am a published AI and robotics researcher, innovator, and social worker. Driven by the challenges I saw growing up in a coastal village in Bangladesh, I engineer award-winning technologies that create tangible social impact, from AI-driven water purification devices to accessible prosthetic arms for amputees. I am a gold medalist at the National Mathematical Olympiad and a silver medalist at the International Robot Olympiad. Alongside my research, I mentor young innovators in STEM and spend my free time traveling and practicing fine arts.
